notes: Embedded, single-writer database file (WAL mode, synchronous=NORMAL). No server, no network, no replication in core; libSQL / rqlite / Litestream provide replication on top of SQLite (see docs).

logging.sink: application-side JSONL slow log (driver wrapper, RDLAB_SQLITE_SLOW_MS)

slow_query.sink: application-side JSONL slow log (driver wrapper, RDLAB_SQLITE_SLOW_MS)
slow_query.sample: {"ts": "2026-09-14T08:38:49.596+00:00", "duration_ms": 544.196, "pid": 1317408, "database": "data/sqlite/lab.db", "sql": "WITH RECURSIVE c(x) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT x + 1 FROM c WHERE x < 2000000) SELECT COUNT(*) AS rdlab_mk_60c26077fc FROM c"}

audit.mechanism: n/a (no server; use the same wrapper or SQLite's sqlite3_trace_v2 hook)

overhead.workload: SELECT id, name, email FROM customers WHERE id = ?
overhead.full_logging: RDLAB_SQLITE_SLOW_MS=0 (every statement appended to slow.jsonl by every worker process)
